description: This file defines a React-style component for a Tic Tac Toe game using the Qwik framework. It includes game logic, state management, and UI rendering for the game, handling user interactions, win/draw detection, and scorekeeping.

methods.name: detectWinner
methods.description: Determines if there is a winner on the board by checking all winning line combinations.

methods.name: isDraw
methods.description: Checks if the game is a draw by verifying if all cells are filled.

methods.name: cellClasses
methods.description: Generates CSS class names for each cell to reflect its state and if part of a winning line.

methods.name: statusText
methods.description: Returns JSX to display the current game status message.
